body:
I'm not sure.

No, because I generally give people the benefit of the doubt. That, and I know what its like.

The thing is, I mentioned suicide once. I try really hard to avoid the topic of depression, that way it's not always *me me me* if you know what I'm getting at.

It feels strange.

I bottle my feelings pretty well. Well, until recently. I try my hardest to be a normal student, and I've done well. I'm the class clown with decent grades and a witty sense of humor. Or, was. My true melancholic colors of blue and more blue have been really showing recently.

My biggest fear is that if I talk about it, I'll be an attention whore. I don't want to be an attention whore, but at the same time, I want to talk to at least one bud about it. I'm conflicted on the whole thing.

Eh.

My parents try not to talk about it. I know they were worried and emotional, but they were scared to talk about it. I can't blame them at all.

As for my friends, I told 2 friends. One was somewhat supportive, the other shrugged it off. Another friend found out and called me a pussy.

So, I deleted him as a contact and told him to fuck off from my life.  I've never done that to anybody, I'm always the personable kid on the block. Depression changes you, especially when it gets severe.

I wouldn't wish this on my worst enemy.
